name: hcoll_link_e2v

pin_regs.reason: ot_hgi_coll_link_e2 (the leaf body) captures every input at a pin flop before any check (eb copies, *_pin) and every output is a flop Q (seq p_tx_v/p_tx_flit, rx_v/rx_flit, epoch_abort/fault_cause; retry_requested = epoch_abort Q); a synthesis pin stage would add an unbenched edge to the static link calendar

structural_change: FAM-HBM-A/COLLQ10 10-21 (FALLBACK): hcoll_link_e2t route (2d5040f13) NEEDS_RTL TT -109.51; worst TT setup = rf -> 580-b RX CRC XOR tree (~10 XNOR levels) -> 32-b compare -> OR4/OR4 -> fault/valid gating -> rx_v / epoch_abort copies, ~22 levels / ~890 ps data in ONE cycle (gate path_classes already showed reg->reg -110). CLASS logic depth (clock spine fine: spread 33.6/32.1, insertion equal at both ends; wire buffering secondary). FIX RTL: RX CRC computed one edge earlier from the pin stage (rx_pin_flit_pin) and its 32 per-bit mismatches registered beside rf; crc_bad = |rx_crc_mm (bit/edge-identical, 0 added cycles). Geometry/spine = hcoll_link_e2t unchanged. Internal route hold margin 0.03 -> 0.05 ns (predecessor FF residuals: e2s -3.37 flop->SRAM wd_in, e2t -22.92 store dout->q_pin across spine leaves).
